# Ordinance No. 011, Series of 2018

**Ordinance Authorizing Use of Savings for Augmentation**

## Summary

This ordinance authorizes the [[Municipal Mayor]] and/or the [[Presiding Officer]] of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] to utilize savings for augmentation purposes, in accordance with the [[Local Government Code of 1991]]. It defines "savings" and "augmentation" in the context of budget management and specifies the priority for using personal services savings. The ordinance takes effect on [[2018-12-17]].

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1. Use of Savings and Augmentation.** In accordance with [[Sec-336-RA7160|Section 336]] of [[RA-7160|Republic Act No. 7160]], the [[Municipal Mayor]] and/or the [[Presiding Officer]] of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] are authorized to augment any item in the approved annual budget for their respective offices from savings in other items within the same expense class of their respective appropriations. "Savings" refer to portions or balances of any programmed appropriation free from any obligation or encumbrance, still available after the satisfactory completion or the unavoidable discontinuance or abandonment of the work, activity or purpose for which the appropriation is authorized or arising or unpaid compensation and related costs pertaining to vacant positions and leaves of absence without pay. "Augmentation" implies the existence in the budget of an item, project, activity or purpose with an appropriation which upon implementation or subsequent evaluation of needed resources is determined to be deficient.
2.  **Section 2. Priority in the Use of Personal Services Savings.** Priority shall be given to the personnel benefits o local employees in the use of Personal services savings.
3.  **Section 3. Separability Clause.** If, for any reason, any section or provision of this Ordinance is declared invalid or unconstitutional, other sections or provisions thereof which are not affected thereby shall continue to be in full force and effect.
4.  **Section 4. Effectivity.** The provisions of this Ordinance shall take effect on December 17, 2018.
